payload.body:
## Pull request overview

Redesigns Eventra’s homepage and shared UI into a neutral, minimalist directory experience with search, filters, grids, and local bookmarks.

**Changes:**
- Replaces carousel discovery with a searchable, tagged gallery.
- Redesigns cards, drawer, navigation, footer, skeletons, and global styling.
- Adds bookmark controls, navbar indicators, and host/newsletter CTAs.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 12 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Summary | Review notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src/components/ui/TrendingEventCard.jsx` | Redesigned trending event card with bookmarks. | Bookmark control is hover-only on touch and keyboard. **Nit.** |
| `src/components/ui/Skeleton.jsx` | Updated loading placeholders. | No final comments. |
| `src/components/ui/ProjectCard.jsx` | Redesigned project card with actions. | Actions are hover-only on touch and keyboard. **Nit.** |
| `src/components/ui/HackathonCard.jsx` | Redesigned hackathon card with bookmarks. | Bookmark control is hover-only on touch and keyboard. **Nit.** |
| `src/components/ui/EventCard.jsx` | Redesigned event card with bookmarks. | Bookmark control is hover-only on touch and keyboard. **Nit.** |
| `src/components/ui/DetailDrawer.jsx` | Simplified detail drawer styling. | No final comments. |
| `src/components/Navbar.jsx` | Added minimalist navigation and bookmark count. | Bookmark route is unimplemented, and the count can remain stale after same-window changes. **Moderate.** |
| `src/components/home/WhatsHappeningNow.jsx` | Added filtered directory grid. | Reset Filters does not clear the parent-owned search query. **Moderate.** |
| `src/components/home/HostCTA.jsx` | Added submission and newsletter CTAs. | Newsletter is not persisted or sent; submission copy does not match the destination; guidelines link leads to a missing route. **Moderate.** |
| `src/components/home/Hero.jsx` | Added editorial hero and search. | Search input lacks an accessible label. **Nit.** |
| `src/components/Footer.jsx` | Simplified footer content. | Saved Bookmarks link leads to an unimplemented view. **Moderate.** |
| `src/app/page.jsx` | Simplified homepage composition. | No final comments. |
| `src/app/layout.jsx` | Updated global page styling. | No final comments. |
| `src/app/globals.css` | Added neutral theme styling. | No final comments. |
</details>





<details>
<summary>Suppressed comments (25)</summary>

**src/components/Footer.jsx:10**
* `ArrowUpRight`, `Bookmark`, and `Plus` are no longer rendered in the footer. Keeping them in this changed import makes the repository's ESLint no-unused-vars rule fail; remove the stale imports.
```
  ArrowUpRight,
  Bookmark,
  Plus
```
**src/components/Navbar.jsx:255**
* This close button contains only an icon and has no accessible name. Add an `aria-label` so screen-reader users can close the mobile navigation.
```
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                    className="p-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-900 rounded-md transition-colors"
                  >
                    <X className="w-5 h-5" />
```
**src/components/Navbar.jsx:305**
* These newly visible mobile navigation links point to `/about`, `/resources`, and `/help`, but none of those routes exists under `src/app`, so each link leads to a 404 page. Use existing routes or add the corresponding pages before exposing them in navigation.
```
                      <Link href="/about" onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)} className="block hover:text-neutral-950">About Eventra</Link>
                      <Link href="/resources" onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)} className="block hover:text-neutral-950">Resources & Docs</Link>
                      <Link href="/help" onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)} className="block hover:text-neutral-950">Help & Support</Link>
`
